description: This file contains the implementation of the DashboardService class which interacts with an API client to fetch dashboard category summaries, including error handling and data parsing.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Service class to fetch dashboard-related summaries, specifically category summaries, via API calls.

methods.name: categorySummaries
methods.description: Fetches a list of category summaries for a given month from the API, handles errors gracefully, and parses the JSON data into CategorySummary objects.
